translation: Wiem… Lillian ma plan… Ostrożnie wybiera, komu pozwala go zobaczyć…

source_text: Otherwise, it would probably already be too late.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Otherwise, it would probably already be too late.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Otherwise, it would probably already be too late."

translation: W przeciwnym razie pewnie byłoby już za późno.

source_text: You will succeed, 1Hero. It is God’s will.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.You will succeed, 1Hero. It is God’s will.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.You will succeed, 1Hero. It is God’s will."

translation: Uda ci się, 1Hero. Taka jest wola Boga.

source_text: I should give Nellie a call… Perhaps she can help me figure out this briefcase.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I should give Nellie a call… Perhaps she can help me figure out this briefcase.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I should give Nellie a call… Perhaps she can help me figure out this briefcase."

translation: Powinienem zadzwonić do Nellie… Może pomoże mi rozgryźć tę teczkę.

source_text: Hi, Nellie. I have some questions for you.

structure.raw_value: McFrOpNo4.Hi, Nellie. I have some questions for you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOpNo4.Hi, Nellie. I have some questions for you."

translation: Cześć, Nellie. Chciałem cię o coś zapytać.

source_text: Uh oh, it’s Detective Canmore. Should I be worried?

structure.raw_value: NeFlDe.Uh oh, it’s Detective Canmore. Should I be worried?
structure.script_literal: "NeFlDe.Uh oh, it’s Detective Canmore. Should I be worried?"

translation: Oho, detektyw Canmore. Mam się martwić?

source_text: Heh, no. But you know my dad better than anyone.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Heh, no. But you know my dad better than anyone.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Heh, no. But you know my dad better than anyone."

translation: Heh, nie. Ale znasz mojego ojca lepiej niż ktokolwiek.

source_text: I’m trying to break into an old briefcase of his, but I don’t know the code.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’m trying to break into an old briefcase of his, but I don’t know the code.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’m trying to break into an old briefcase of his, but I don’t know the code."

translation: Próbuję otworzyć jego starą teczkę, ale nie znam szyfru.

source_text: Any ideas?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Any ideas?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Any ideas?"

translation: Masz jakiś pomysł?

source_text: An old briefcase? I don’t know anything about that.

structure.raw_value: NeAnDe.An old briefcase? I don’t know anything about that.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnDe.An old briefcase? I don’t know anything about that."

translation: Starą teczkę? Nic o niej nie wiem.

source_text: But codes…

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.But codes…
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.But codes…"

translation: Ale szyfry…

source_text: The Eclipse Guild had a system for generating codes, back when the Guild had several leaders.

structure.raw_value: NeBaEx.The Eclipse Guild had a system for generating codes, back when the Guild had several leaders.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaEx.The Eclipse Guild had a system for generating codes, back when the Guild had several leaders."

translation: Gdy Gildią Zaćmienia kierowało kilka osób, mieli system generowania szyfrów.

source_text: I wasn’t really involved at the time the system was developed, so I can’t help you with that.

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.I wasn’t really involved at the time the system was developed, so I can’t help you with that.
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.I wasn’t really involved at the time the system was developed, so I can’t help you with that."

translation: Nie brałam udziału w tworzeniu tego systemu, więc nie potrafię ci pomóc.

source_text: Sorry, 1Hero. Wish I could be more help.

structure.raw_value: NeWoDe.Sorry, 1Hero. Wish I could be more help.
structure.script_literal: "NeWoDe.Sorry, 1Hero. Wish I could be more help."

translation: Przykro mi, 1Hero. Chciałabym bardziej pomóc.

source_text: No, it’s okay. I’ll figure it out.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.No, it’s okay. I’ll figure it out.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.No, it’s okay. I’ll figure it out."

translation: Nie szkodzi. Sam coś wymyślę.

source_text: Busy, then?

structure.raw_value: NeFlDe.Busy, then?
structure.script_literal: "NeFlDe.Busy, then?"

translation: Czyli masz teraz urwanie głowy?

source_text: Yeah, you could say I’m on a case.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Yeah, you could say I’m on a case.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Yeah, you could say I’m on a case."

translation: Można tak powiedzieć. Prowadzę śledztwo.
